query: How do I make pan-fried dumplings using pre-made ones?

goal.title: Pan-fry dumplings and serve with dressing
goal.description: Light the burner beneath a pan, add corn oil and place four prepared dumplings into the oil. Move and turn the dumplings with a red spatula as their surfaces brown, fetch a creamy dressing from the refrigerator, then plate the dumplings and add dressing at the table.
goal.final_state: Four browned dumplings sit on a plate with a small amount of creamy dressing; a fork rests beside them.
procedure: Turn on the burner and retrieve corn oil from the cabinet.
Pour oil into the pan and return the bottle.
Place four dumplings into the pan.
Move and turn the dumplings with a spatula while they brown.
Bring dressing from the refrigerator to the table.
Finish turning and transfer the dumplings to a plate.
Put the spatula in the sink, take a fork and carry the plate to the table.
Pour dressing beside the dumplings and handle them with the fork.

phases.description: The burner is lit, corn oil retrieved from the lower cabinet, poured into the pan, recapped and returned before the cabinet closes.
Each dumpling is lifted from the plate, adjusted by hand and placed into the oil; fingers are rubbed and wiped afterward.
The red spatula slides under the dumplings and repeatedly nudges or turns them before being placed on the empty plate.
The refrigerator is opened, a creamy dressing bottle taken out and carried to the table.
The spatula repeatedly turns and repositions the dumplings, revealing browned patches, then lifts one as the plate is taken.
Four successive spatula transfers move the dumplings out of the pan and their positions on the plate are adjusted.
The spatula is put into the sink, a fork taken from the drawer, and the plate carried to the table with the fork placed beside the food.
The dressing bottle is opened and tilted over the plate, then recapped and set down; the fork presses into a dumpling.
